bayts.text: I have turned praise to Allah, and He honoured me through the Chosen, and through him bestowed safety on me.
"Truly the Messenger is a sword from which light is drawn, an Indian blade among the swords of Allah", Possessor of favours.
The way of the Messenger, whose like is no man, (is) a way by which I attained the obligatory and the sunnas.
The purity of the radiant Sunna has dispelled the darkness from me, and the heart has become good like the body.
His Book has preserved me from every corruption, and held back harm from me, as it effaced vain play.
It became clear to me that the Book of Allah has no like, and it led me beyond the request by the rein.
My knowledge, my religion and my habit have become sound through it; through it I awaken the people of the age from drowsiness.
The Chosen has with the Lord of humankind a rank surpassing the ranks of the people of fame and power.
Allah preferred him from pre-eternity and glorified him, and there shall be no like for him, nor has there been.
I served the best of creation at sea, with the service of one whom a Generous Lord rewarded, and he rose with "Be".
I have already composed, among those who made the Eternal Refuge a trinity, from "Say: He, Allah, is One" that whose equal has not appeared.
I fought a devil at sea, and the best of creation, the Elect, among his learned Companions, hurled him down.
Upon him, of the blessings of Allah, the best, in the Family and the Companions, those who triumphed without stain.
The shade of the Prophet, the Messenger of Allah, shaded me, and cut from me what held (me) back like a rope.
O Lord, bless with peace my support, and the Family and the Companions, O Lord of safety and of time.
Accept from me through him my praise, according to Your measure, O You Who bestow on me through him with gladness and safety.
